title: Where can i find the Whiplash script?

commenti.body: Unless there is a shooting script released you’ll probably not find what you are looking for. Download the script from various different sites and compare the versions to see if they’re different. Movies often don’t release the iteration of the screenplay used in production

You have to remember that a tremendous amount of content is edited out before the final product hits the big screen. But all that extra material will still appear in the script, because the actors still need to act it out. Similar to what /u/addictivesign said, I actually don't believe an official, 100%-true-to-the-end-product script would exist for ANY movie.
Aight thanks man, just needed to know bcs if there is one then i couldnt use the one i have for the paper or i might get points deducted

Using the Wayback Machine and the knowledge of how this screenplay was put forward and shared for a best screenplay Oscar nomination, and which studio distributed it, I present you the final shooting script straight from the distributor:

https://web.archive.org/web/20190120075842/https://www.sonyclassics.com/awards-information/whiplash_screenplay.pdf

I haven't done a side by side comparison with what you shared, but this one comes from the source.

Hey man, you are a lifesaver. I got only a few days to finish the paper. From what i saw, it's similar, but nonetheless helps getting the script from Sony themselves (from what i read, sonyclassics is the most official site i could get that from, correct me if im wrong) 

Thanks
Sony Pictures Classics distributed the film, yes. They hosted this version of the screenplay on their site during the Oscar bid for 2015. The film was nominated but didn't win that Oscar.

Any script that perfectly matches the finished movie got conformed by a script coordinator (unsung heroes) after the edit is locked. 

Here’s a good video John August made comparing one crucial scene in Whiplash to the finished movie:
